Hi Jane —

Thanks — great questions. Short answers up front, then details and recommended next steps below.

1) Invoicing: If you purchase through AWS Marketplace with a private offer, the invoice typically comes from AWS (Marketplace) and will show the Marketplace transaction; Acme can pay AWS and AWS will remit to Redwood per the private offer. If you prefer a Redwood-originated invoice (straight to your AP for PO matching), the direct route (signed MSA + purchase order to Redwood) is the simplest.

2) Co-sell credits/incentives: Co-sell credits are tied to partner/channel arrangements. When we do a direct, signed MSA and Redwood is listed as Seller of Record, we can apply partner incentives directly on the invoice or via rebate. Marketplace private offers can still support co-sell crediting, but the mechanics differ — credits are often allocated via the marketplace settlement or via the cloud partner's reporting. That can add a small reconciliation step for partner ops.

3) SKUs / Pricing: Marketplace private offers let us publish explicit SKUs and private pricing; the unit economics are generally equivalent but sometimes pricing is bundled differently (e.g., marketplace SKU for a fixed committed seat or credits bundle). For example, a committed TPU/GPU seat SKU in the private offer may have a different billing cadence than a monthly invoice under an MSA.

Recommended next steps:
- If Acme needs Redwood invoices for PO matching, opt for direct contracting (signed MSA + Redwood invoice).
- If you need faster procurement through your internal cloud procurement tooling or want to leverage cloud credits, we can do a private offer on AWS Marketplace and provide a SKU map + settlement guidance.

I attached a quick SKU map and a draft MSA excerpt for your finance/legal teams to review. I've looped in Lauren from Legal/Finance and Karthik from Partner Ops to confirm co-sell credit mechanics.

Best,

Hi Jane / Soojin —

Adding a legal/finance perspective. Key tradeoffs we see in practice: 

- Invoice ownership: Marketplace invoices are issued by the cloud provider. Some enterprise AP teams require vendor-issued invoices with Redwood on the remit-to line; those teams usually prefer direct MSA invoicing.
- Tax & compliance: Marketplace purchases can simplify tax calculations in some regions but introduce a different remit-to and tax documentation flow. If Acme has particular tax-facing requirements (e.g., exempt certificate, VAT registrations), send over the specifics and we can advise.
- Contractual terms: The MSA gives you direct contractual rights with Redwood (SLA, data residency, security annexes). Marketplace private offers can be paired with a separate MSA, but that adds complexity to enforcement. 
- Co-sell credits: Karthik (Partner Ops) — FYI: for AWS private offers we can confirm partner crediting via the marketplace settlement; if Acme wants co-sell attribution to a specific channel rep we should confirm the partner registration window and provide the SOW/quote lines.

If it helps, we can:
1) Provide a clean Redwood invoice template for direct purchase.
2) Provide a marketplace SKU-to-invoice mapping and settlement timeline for AWS (30–45 days typical).

Jane — if you can share which AP workflow your team must satisfy (e.g., invoice must list vendor EIN and Redwood as seller), we'll recommend the exact path.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop

Jane —

Good news: hybrid is common and feasible. Practical flow we recommend: 

1) Execute the Redwood MSA so Acme has vendor-backed terms and Redwood-origin invoices for AP (we will issue invoices with Redwood as seller and our EIN). This satisfies your PO matching requirement.

2) Concurrently we can publish a private offer on AWS Marketplace tied to the same commercial terms/quote. The private offer lets CloudPath and AWS register the transaction for co-sell crediting while Acme continues to pay Redwood directly against invoices (or we can route payment via AWS if you prefer that path).

3) Operational notes: we will need to map SKUs in the private offer to Redwood invoice line items (we provided a draft SKU map). Partner crediting typically requires the partner registration within a short window (usually at time of purchase or reporting period). Karthik will coordinate the partner registration and settlement details.

- Jane: send back any AP vendor fields we must include on the invoice (EIN, remit address, PO number format).
